label: Sinai Arabic NF M 8, Undertext (Greek majuscule)

note.value: This text was written by the same scribe who copied the UTO Basil of Caesarea, Homily on the on Thanksgiving in this codex. These two texts belonged to the same original manuscript

Fragment 21r (upper outer piece), 21v (upper outer piece) possibly also belongs to this text; fragments 86r (gutter lower piece), 86v (gutter lower piece), 116r (lower piece), 116v (lower piece), could also belong to this text (Rossetto)

bib.citation: Boudalis, Georgios, and Giulia Rossetto. "Colour Mapping of Sin. ar. NF 8 + Sin. ar. NF 28." In M. P. Brown and J. Lockhart, eds. The Apollonius of Tyre Fragment in Arabic NF 8: Studies of a Latin Palimpsest at St Catherine’s Monastery, Sinai. [Forthcoming]

program.label: Sinai Palimpsests Project
program.description: Imaged and studied as part of the Sinai Palimpsests Project (2011–2016), a collaboration between St. Catherine’s Monastery of the Sinai, the Early Manuscripts Electronic Library, and UCLA Library, funded by the Arcadia Fund and the Ahmanson Foundation. The project used multispectral imaging and scholarly analysis to recover and document erased and obscured texts in palimpsest manuscripts from the monastery’s collection.
